mechanism: Bisacodyl may reduce oral bioavailability of bisphosphonates through increased GI motility and reduced absorption time; zoledronic acid (IV) bypasses this concern but bisacodyl-induced diarrhea increases dehydration risk, potentially compromising renal function critical for zoledronic acid clearance.
action: Monitor renal function and hydration status; separate oral bisphosphonate administration from bisacodyl by at least 2 hours; ensure adequate fluid intake if laxative use is necessary.
